en.headline: Light Rail rides free all day on Mid-Autumn Festival
en.dek: MTR says the entire Light Rail network will waive fares from the first train on 25 September until 11.59pm, covering Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tin Shui Wai.
body: The MTR Corporation said Light Rail journeys will be free on Friday, 25 September, the Mid-Autumn Festival public holiday, from the first service of the day until 11.59pm.

The arrangement applies to the whole Light Rail network in Tuen Mun, Yuen Long and Tin Shui Wai. Passengers without an Octopus card may board without buying a ticket. Those using Octopus cards should still tap in and out as usual; the corporation said no Light Rail fare will be deducted during the free period.

MTR said interchange concessions involving MTR Buses feeding Light Rail and then another MTR Bus will not apply automatically that day. Passengers seeking a refund of the last bus fare may apply at designated customer service centres on or before 1 October, including those at Tuen Mun, Siu Hong, Tin Shui Wai, Long Ping and Yuen Long stations.

The free-ride day is being presented with Huatai International and the Strive and Rise Programme as the sixth edition of the Light Rail festive offer. MTR said the concession cannot generally be combined with other promotions, and MTR Points will not apply during the free period.

zh.headline: 中秋正日輕鐵全日免費 八達通仍須拍卡
zh.dek: 港鐵宣布9月25日中秋節由頭班車起至晚上11時59分，屯門、元朗及天水圍輕鐵全線免收車費。
body: 港鐵公司宣布，9月25日中秋節公眾假期，輕鐵將由當日頭班車起至晚上11時59分免收車費。
優惠覆蓋屯門、元朗及天水圍整個輕鐵網絡。沒有八達通的乘客可不用購票直接乘車；持八達通的乘客則須如常拍卡出入，港鐵表示該時段不會扣除輕鐵車資。
港鐵指出，當日如使用港鐵巴士接駁輕鐵再轉乘另一程港鐵巴士，轉乘優惠不能自動套用。乘客如要取回最後一程巴士車費，可於10月1日或之前到指定客務中心辦理，包括屯門、兆康、天水圍、朗屏及元朗站。
是次免費乘車日由華泰國際聯同「共創明Teen計劃」舉辦，為第六屆輕鐵節日乘車安排。港鐵表示，除另有註明外，優惠一般不可與其他推廣同時使用，期間亦不適用MTR分獎賞。
